name: com.paysafe-agent/paysafe
description: Payment security firewall for x402 micropayments. Scan outgoing/incoming payments for PII & secret leakage, nonce replay, overpayment, and prompt-injection-triggered payments; check/file counterparty reputation reports; verify Ed25519 verdict attestations locally; browse and subscribe to plans. Advisory and non-custodial.

environmentVariables.name: PAYSAFE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PaySafe API key (mint one free with the mint_api_key tool or POST /v1/keys — first 100 calls free). Optional.

environmentVariables.name: PAYSAFE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PaySafe instance URL. Defaults to https://paysafe-agent.com.
